limitations: Native package validation and LibreOffice checks do not establish repair-free Microsoft Office opening or full schema conformance.
Repeated comments and endnotes cannot share a story; overlapping comment/note anchors are rejected because LibreOffice misrenders endnote text.
Charts require literal category data; workbook-linked charts, pivots and combination charts are rejected.
SVG is a passive geometry subset rasterized to PNG.
ODS rewriting covers local A1 references; unchanged static formulas are preserved.
SQRT of a negative number uses Excel #NUM!; LibreOffice 26.2 returns #VALUE!. Independent comparison checks IFERROR and unit tests check Excel errors.
Migration requires an offline source backup and an empty, stopped destination; it does not switch application traffic.
